name: avista-wp-algolia-chunker
description: Keep WordPress + Algolia records under the 100KB hard limit (and the ~10KB relevance budget) by chunking long text the right way — route big content through the chunked `content` path of wp-search-with-algolia (which splits via Algolia_Utils::explode_content with distinct), keep small fields as shared attributes, and for non-plugin/custom-attribute cases use a standalone word-boundary chunker that emits {id}-{n} distinct records. Covers long bodies, denormalized search blobs, and extracted PDF text.
